snippet.title: 【Indie Horror Game】Jumpscare Slayer【PV】
snippet.description:
A 3D first-person horror game in which you must solve the mysteries of the mansion, escape enemies, and find the hidden sword.
Dodge the gaze of terrifying monsters, obtain the legendary sword, and slay the monsters that threaten the world.
